caption: A ray of sunlight hits a glass prism on a windowsill, and a band of rainbow colours appears on the wall.

sa.check: A glass prism sits on a windowsill.
A ray of sunlight hits it.
A band of rainbow colours appears on the wall.
The band moves when the prism is turned.
The band lies on the side away from the sun.

pc.expect: The coloured band appears on the side away from the sun and would disappear if the prism were removed.
pc.fail: It is on the sun side; or there with no prism; or the prism is in sunlight with no band.

pc.expect: The band moves only when the prism is turned.
pc.fail: It drifts with the prism still; or stays put while the prism turns; or flickers in steady sun.

pc.expect: The band shows the spectrum's order.
pc.fail: It is a single colour; or the order is random; or it changes colours with the prism steady.

pc.expect: The band is one elongated strip.
pc.fail: It splits into several; or is a round spot; or floods the wall.
A second prism appears; or the band becomes solid; or the prism vanishes.

pc.expect: The sill and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: The sill changes; or the wall changes colour; or the prism changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
